column1: # P1 (never present an unsourced number as a finding) at the seeding layer.
# Every value below must be traceable to a published source
# reproduced verbatim in the report appendix a city planner reads.
# Columns (all required
#   code                 stable identifier
#   category             one of: water | green | shade | material
#   name                 human label shown in the UI
#   unit                 the unit `quantity` is counted in
#   unit_cost_usd        installed capital cost per unit
#   delta_c_low          most conservative published cooling effect
#   delta_c_high         least conservative published cooling effect
#                        must satisfy delta_c_low < delta_c_high
#   lifespan_years       service life used for annualised cost
#   maintenance_usd_yr   recurring cost per unit per year
#   feasibility_rule     JSON object of tile-feature preconditions
#                        e.g. {"max_canopy_pct": 40
#   source_citation      full citation. MUST NOT BE EMPTY — the database
#                        loader and the startup gate each reject an empty value.
# Sign convention: cooling is negative
# everywhere else in the system. A positive delta would describe warming.
# Example of the expected shape (commented out — the numbers are placeholders
# not sourced values
# street_tree_medium
column11: Author, A. (Year). Title. Journal, vol(issue), pages. DOI
